summary: Bounded numerical comparison repair probe on the same two saved real-model programs and 1,024 declared Local rows as the earlier frozen probe. Job 15872 used one L40 for 48 allocated seconds; wrapper time 46.250 seconds, peak host RSS 2,680,528,896 bytes. No fitting or candidate-family expansion occurred.
method: Max-rescaled row norms and native RMS scale enclosures avoid raw-square underflow and overflow. Exact zero over zero is zero; a nonzero value over a denominator interval containing zero stays explicitly unresolved. The bounds cover binary64 supplied writes, the native RMS computation and their final subtraction and norm under IEEE round-to-nearest with gradual underflow; this assumption is not verified at run time, and the bounds do not cover either neural forward computation.
results: Extreme, subnormal and zero fixtures passed on CUDA. The four full-panel pairs had bitwise equal host and resident CUDA norm centers, overlapping outward intervals, and identical declared CPU, CUDA and resident classifications. Every frozen earlier classification was unchanged; interval widths differ. Copy Local was 0.2125465; nonlinear MLP Local was 1.4207657. This validates the backend comparison; it is not a fidelity improvement.
